notes: 'it received' — the 'it' is added: the participle is not a finite verb and the suffixes s003/s007 already hold their own pronouns (rule 25).
Second 'like' before the appositional פֶּרַח שׁוֹשַׁנָּה is the bare nominal's under rule 33 (appositional nominal with supplied preposition), not a distributed repetition of the כְּ.
